The '''Trilon sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], at the boundary with the [[Unknown Regions]], that and included [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattatak]], [[Zaddja/Legends|Zaddja]] and the [[Gannaria system/Legends|Gannaria system]]. It was known for its [[Spice/Legends|spice]] production.
